title: Screen: when drying ends, the drying page's Start button is enabled again, and a drying stopped early (from Fluidd) leaves the drying page like Stop on the screen
note: The drying settings page keeps a pointer to its Start button (saved in a free slot of .q2_queue_state when the page is drawn). When the drying state changes to 'not drying', the Start button is re-evaluated with QIDI's own rule (disabled only while the printer is busy), queued on the screen's GUI thread exactly like QIDI's own observer does. Stop on the screen sends QIDI's stop command but no longer calls QIDI's 'back' right after it (one instruction): the drying end is then handled by QIDI's own drying-state code exactly like a drying whose time is up, so every drying end - time up, Stop on the screen, a stop from Fluidd or the console - ends on the drying settings page. A Stop usually means something is not as wanted (filament, temperature or time to change), so the settings are the useful place to land; 'back' from there still leads to the Function list. Code: 15 instructions in the free part of .q2_queue_text.
